name: stable-diffusion.cpp - FLUX.2 Klein 9B
notes: For FLUX.2 Klein 9B, the distilled 4-step model, in stable-diffusion.cpp. A coloring page takes 12 steps for clean closed outlines, and it can edit a picture handed to it as a reference. The undistilled base model shares the name but needs many more steps: it renders badly on this harness.

childrensColoringBook.about: a page of a children's coloring book
childrensColoringBook.prompt: Black and white line art illustration of {subject}, drawn for a young child to color in. Thick, clean, closed black outlines of even weight on a pure white background. Large simple shapes with big empty white areas inside them, a cute and friendly cartoon style. The whole drawing is shown complete, with plenty of empty white space around it and nothing cut off at the edges. No shading, no gray tones, no color, no hatching, no texture, no text.
